dedupe_keys.name: aemo nemweb australian national electricity market and gas market report files current archive and mms data model

description: NEMWeb is the public file server of the Australian Energy Market Operator (AEMO) for the National Electricity Market (NEM) and several gas markets. The current reports directory, read on 2026-09-26 with files time-stamped that day, holds more than 100 report folders, among them five-minute dispatch SCADA readings of generating units, dispatch and pre-dispatch prices and solutions, operational demand, rooftop PV estimates, network outages and high-impact outages, marginal loss factors, market notices, medium- and short-term PASA availability, seven-day outlooks, settlements, and gas folders for the Victorian declared wholesale gas market, the short-term trading market and the gas bulletin board. Reports are published as zipped CSV files named by report and interval, for example one DISPATCHSCADA file every five minutes. A report archive and the MMS Data Model archive by year from 2009 hold older files. Access is anonymous; the AEMO pages carrying copyright terms returned 403 to automated reading, so the terms were not read. Caveats: files follow the MMS data model and need its documentation, and the folder layout is technical. Simulation uses are unit-level dispatch and price studies, rooftop PV and demand modelling, and validation of NEM models. Related records: data-elexon-insights-solution-bmrs-api is the comparable Great Britain source.
